claim.proposition: Configured accepted observations produce the expected threshold, application-state, and visible-UI behavior.
claim.assuranceTarget: Application state model and visible UI

supportedInterpretation: For the recorded configuration and inputs, BLE-decoded observations produced the expected application-state transitions and visible UI states.
exclusions: This assessment does not by itself support general BLE reliability, RF-performance, alternate-device, provenance, regulatory, or deployment-environment claims.
residualUncertainty: The catalog contains identified properties and may omit unknown dependencies.
Behavior outside the recorded inputs, versions, devices, and observation bounds was not evaluated.
